sample_unit: pediatric mental health emergency department visits
models_evaluated: Large Language Model Meta AI (Llama)-derived scores

links.outcome: Detection AUROC by demographic and diagnostic subgroups across structured, text, and hybrid methods
links.effect: Low-dimensional structured method varied by subgroup (preadolescents 0.821 vs adolescents 0.880; males 0.817 vs females 0.902). Hybrid aCS+LLaMA gave AUROC ≥0.90 for all 20 demographic and 12/15 diagnostic subgroups.
links.quote: Hybrid modality (aCS+Large Language Model Meta AI) achieved optimal performance (AUROC=0.977), with AUROC ≥0.90 for all 20 demographic and 12/15 diagnostic subgroups.

unlisted_practices: Combining structured EHR data with NLP/LLM-derived note scores to improve detection of suicide and self-harm-related ED visits

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates multimodal NLP and ML models (including Llama/LLaMA-derived scores) on retrospective pediatric ED EHR data to detect suicide/self-harm visits and assesses demographic/diagnostic performance subgroup variability (algorithmic fairness/equity), but does not test an organizational deployment guardrail or practice.
